capabilities: Run customizable work and break interval timers
Play audible alerts at the end of each session
Display timer progress in the status bar
Log finished sessions into daily notes with simple, verbose, or Templater-based templates
Update a pomodoro count inline field on the task in focus
extras: Custom notification sounds require placing an audio file in the vault and setting its vault-relative path; task tracking needs an inline pomodoros field placed before Tasks plugin fields to avoid rendering issues.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in timer for focus sessions, so users doing the Pomodoro Technique must leave the app or track sessions manually.

relations.evidence: This DataView script generates a table showing Pomodoro sessions with their durations
Ensure to add this inline-field before the Tasks plugin's fields

summary: Pomodoro timer that runs customizable work/break sessions with audio alerts, status bar display, daily note logging, and task tracking.
